Home/Blog/Psychology institutions in Delhi NCR

Student and academic guide

Psychology institutions in Delhi NCR: programmes, syllabi, and internships

In short: Delhi NCR offers university, hospital, open-learning, forensic, and community-psychology routes. Programme names, accreditation, placement support, and practicum rules change, so students should confirm the current prospectus and written internship requirements directly with each institution.

Choosing a psychology programme is not only about the degree title. Compare the curriculum, the kind of supervision available, the setting in which practical work occurs, the documentation your course requires, and whether the pathway matches your long-term qualification plans.

Greater Noida and Greater Noida West

IILM University

IILM’s Greater Noida and Gurugram campuses are associated with undergraduate psychology and applied-psychology routes. Students commonly look for a curriculum that combines psychological foundations with applied social psychology, assessment, and qualitative research. Ask the programme office how fieldwork, laboratory learning, and later-semester internships are documented for your cohort.

Sharda University

Sharda offers psychology pathways that may include undergraduate and postgraduate study. Its medical-university setting can be relevant to students seeking exposure to clinical and health contexts. Confirm the current course approval, supervised placement locations, psychiatric-ward access, and the exact assessment responsibilities permitted for students.

Galgotias University

Galgotias psychology programmes combine theory with counselling skills, research statistics, and behavioural analysis. Students considering the postgraduate route should confirm whether internship credits are compulsory in their intake, what kinds of offline placements qualify, and who signs the final evaluation.

Amity University, Greater Noida

Amity’s psychology offerings span undergraduate and postgraduate study with clinical, behavioural, and evidence-informed components. Prospective students should verify the current regulatory status of each programme, the required supervised hours, and whether practicum work is completed through a hospital, rehabilitation setting, laboratory, or another approved site.

Gautam Buddha University

GBU provides applied and postgraduate psychology routes within a public-university setting, with emphasis on research methods, statistics, and community mental health. Students comparing intensive clinical training should check current eligibility, supervision, dissertation, and full-time attendance requirements before applying.

Noida International University

NIU offers psychology study in the Greater Noida region. Its programme information should be read alongside the current syllabus and internship handbook so students understand how developmental, social, and abnormal-psychology teaching connects to fieldwork and regional placements.

Noida

Amity Institute of Psychology and Allied Sciences

AIPS covers a broad behavioural-science landscape, with possible specialisations across clinical, counselling, organisational, and child and adolescent psychology. Students should compare the laboratory, assessment, school, corporate, and clinical components of the exact programme they are considering rather than assuming that every track has the same practicum.

Jaypee Institute of Information Technology

JIIT is of interest to students who want psychology to intersect with cognitive science, technology, human-computer interaction, or workplace psychometrics. Research-oriented internships may be a good fit for that direction; confirm the current department structure, project supervision, and credit requirements.

Government colleges in Noida

Government colleges may provide a strong foundation in general and applied psychology through a university syllabus. Formal internship administration can differ from private universities, so students should ask faculty about recommendation letters, summer placements, attendance records, and suitable schools, hospitals, or community organisations.

Ghaziabad

CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Delhi NCR

CHRIST’s Delhi NCR campus is known for structured, research-oriented psychology education. Students comparing clinical or counselling pathways should verify the exact current degree, assessment training, fieldwork hours, hospital or NGO links, and the supervision model attached to each course.

Santosh (Deemed to be University)

Santosh’s medical-university environment may appeal to students interested in medical psychology, neuropsychiatry, and clinical diagnostics. Confirm how the attached hospital is used for teaching, which rotations are mandatory, and what students may do under supervision.

HRIT University

HRIT’s psychology courses emphasise scientific foundations, research statistics, cognitive processes, and behavioural analysis. Students should ask how practical projects are assessed and whether placements with schools, NGOs, or corporate training settings meet their university’s formal requirements.

Gurugram

GD Goenka University

GD Goenka offers psychology routes that may include clinical and counselling directions. The exact accreditation and practicum arrangements must be checked for the intake year, including psychodiagnostic training, therapeutic-ethics teaching, supervised hours, and any hospital collaboration.

IILM University, Gurugram

The Gurugram campus offers psychology and applied-psychology study with an experiential emphasis. Students should ask about fieldwork, research showcases, placement support, and whether opportunities in schools, corporate wellness, or clinical settings are observational, research-based, or direct supervised practice.

SGT University

SGT’s medical-college ecosystem may offer routes across clinical and forensic psychology. Confirm current regulatory recognition, hospital rotations, patient-contact boundaries, and case-management supervision before relying on a programme description.

K.R. Mangalam University

K.R. Mangalam’s liberal-arts setting includes psychology routes with contemporary research and therapy orientations. Ask when the mandatory internship occurs, what placement support is provided, and how school, corporate, and clinical roles are distinguished.

Apeejay Stya University, Sohna

Apeejay’s applied-psychology route may suit students seeking child, health, and cross-disciplinary study. Confirm the supervised practicum structure, partner institutions, and assessment documents before enrolling.

Faridabad

Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies

MRIIRS combines behavioural science with psychometric assessment, counselling, and emerging areas such as corporate and sports psychology. Students should verify the current internship mandate and whether placement assistance represents introductions, guaranteed placement, or a student-led search.

Lingaya’s Vidyapeeth

Lingaya’s psychology programmes balance theory with counselling and organisational behaviour. Ask how the internship component is scheduled and what evidence of supervised learning is required for completion.

Government Post Graduate College, Faridabad

Government postgraduate colleges can provide a broad foundation through the affiliated university syllabus. Students may need to arrange summer practical work independently, with faculty guidance and written confirmation of hours and responsibilities.

Delhi and major clinical or research institutions

Institute of Human Behaviour and Allied Sciences

IHBAS is a specialist government mental-health institute where clinical training, research, and service delivery are closely connected. Programme eligibility, selection, patient-contact permissions, and supervision are highly specific; use the current official notification rather than a secondary summary.

Dr B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi

AUD’s psychology and psychosocial clinical studies can interest students who want clinical work considered alongside social justice, identity, gender, sexuality, and marginalisation. Confirm how community research, NGO work, and practicums are assessed in the current curriculum.

University of Delhi and Jamia Millia Islamia

DU colleges and Jamia offer respected psychology pathways with strong foundations in experimental psychology, statistics, and applied areas. Students should ask departments and societies about current summer internships, research assistantships, clinical exposure, and documentation rather than assuming that an internship is automatically part of every programme.

Jamia Hamdard

Jamia Hamdard’s health-science setting may appeal to students interested in mental health, behavioural medicine, psychopharmacology, and multidisciplinary care. Verify the exact course title, current recognition, hospital rotations, and practical assessment rules.

IGNOU

IGNOU’s M.A. Psychology route is designed for flexible study and includes advanced psychology, psychopathology, counselling, and practicum components. Students should read the current programme guide for the relevant practicum code, supervised-hour rules, notebook and report requirements, and approved placement settings.

Central University of Haryana

CUH provides psychology study in a central-university environment with cognitive, social, and clinical foundations. Confirm the current semester-long internship requirements and whether schools, NGOs, or district hospitals meet the programme’s fieldwork criteria.

Forensic and specialised psychology

National Forensic Sciences University, Delhi

NFSU connects psychology with criminal justice, forensic assessment, and behavioural analysis. Students should confirm the exact clinical or forensic route, practical laboratories, law-enforcement permissions, and boundaries around correctional or investigative placements.

LNJN National Institute of Criminology and Forensic Science

Specialist criminology and forensic programmes may combine mental-health assessment with legal and justice settings. Prospective students should verify the current programme title, eligibility, fieldwork sites, supervision, and safeguarding requirements.

Emerging private and deemed universities

O. P. Jindal Global University

JGU’s interdisciplinary psychology and psychosocial rehabilitation routes may suit students interested in community mental health, rehabilitation, and global perspectives. Ask career services which internships are available, what supervision is provided, and how non-psychology entrants are supported.

How to compare an internship or practicum

Before accepting a placement, ask who supervises the work, whether the setting is clinical, counselling, educational, organisational, research, or forensic, what students are allowed to do, how confidentiality is protected, which hours count, and what report or evaluation is issued. A hospital name alone does not establish that an internship is available or appropriate.

Students can also read the Mind Grace internship enquiry guide and the existing IILM internship comparison article. Any opportunity, supervision, schedule, and documentation must be confirmed directly with the institution or placement provider.
